info.name: Spot AI — Spot Connect (beta) Analytics Integration Event Types API
Get all event types for integration

params.name: integration_id
params.description: - ID of the integration that the event types belong to

params.name: limit
params.description: - Number of cameras to return. Max 100

items.docs:
This endpoint returns a paginated list of all integration event types
associated with an integration that the caller has access to.
Event types that the caller does not have access to will not be included
in the response.

params.name: integration_id
params.description: - ID of the integration that the event type belongs to

items.docs:
This endpoint creates a new integration event type.

Users will be able to define their own event schema by specifying
key-value pairs in json schema format conforming to Spot's meta-schema.

info.name: Get integration event type by id

params.name: integration_id
params.description: - ID of the integration that the event type belongs to

params.name: integration_event_type_id
params.description: - ID of the integration event type

items.docs:
This endpoint returns details of an integration event type.
Details include integration event type name and integration event type schema.

params.name: integration_id
params.description: - ID of the integration that the event type belongs to

params.name: integration_event_type_id
params.description: - ID of the integration event type

items.docs: This endpoint can be used to update properties of an integration event type.

params.name: integration_id
